title: rachel-lee oncall scratchpad 2026-03-04
body:
Oncall scratchpad - Rachel Lee (2026-03-04)

Summary:
- Night shift handed over at 08:00 PST. Quiet start, then two pages during morning traffic spike related to embedding service latency.
- Page 1: Embeddings queue backlog (resolved with scaling + config tweak).
- Page 2: Partial routing failures for hostpool-b (investigating, possible config drift).

Timeline / Notes:
07:55 - Handoff notes from Priya: scheduled model rollout for hosted-api scheduled 09:00; watch for 99th pct latency regressions.
08:20 - PagerDuty PD-8921: alerts from metrics-alerts - embeddings-queue-length > 500 for > 5m.
  - Observed backlog on embeddings-worker-3 and worker-7 (GPU nodes). CPU fine, GPU utilization high ~98%.
  - Actions: increased autoscaling min replicas from 3 -> 5 for embeddings pool (via console).
  - Result: backlog drained over ~6 minutes, alert cleared at 08:27.
  - Follow-up: check autoscaler logs to confirm why min didn't maintain earlier. Ticket filed: JIRA:PROD-4872 (embeddings autoscale investigation).

09:10 - ~1% of requests to hosted-api model routing returned 503 from hostpool-b. Error spikes correlated with a newer hostpool config pushed yesterday.
  - Error logs show connection refused from backend instances 10.4.22.11/12 intermittently.
  - Performed ephemeral restart of affected gateways (restart triggered via infra runbook). Partial improvement but still occasional errors.
  - Rollback candidate config: /confluence/SRE/hostpool-configs (see linked runbook).
  - Escalated to infra oncall (Noah) at 09:25 to look at LB health checks and iptables rules.

09:40 - Noah confirmed a stale iptables rule from yesterday's maintenance blocked healthcheck to one AZ. Fixed and reloaded rules; hostpool-b error rate fell to baseline by 09:48.
  - Root cause hypothesis: maintenance job applied a broad iptables rule and the cleanup step failed for hostpool-b.

Action items & TODOs (post-incident):
- [ ] PROD-4872: Investigate why embeddings autoscaler min replicas dropped during morning ramp. (owner: Rachel)
    - Notes: check controller logs 2026-03-04 01:00-09:00, check kube-event spikes.
- [ ] Add a precheck to maintenance job to validate iptables cleanup success and alert if any hostpool healthchecks fail within 15m. (owner: Noah)
- [ ] Add a temporary dashboard panel: embeddings queue length by worker + GPU util correlation. (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Draft a short postmortem outline for hostpool-b healthcheck outage. Include timeline + RCA + preventive actions. (owner: Rachel)

Runbook TODOs / Improvements:
- Embeddings autoscaler runbook missing an explicit step to enforce min-replicas on surge. Add step and sample kubectl patch command. (low-priority)
- Hostpool maintenance runbook: add verification step to run simple healthcheck script against all AZs (script location: /ops/tools/hc-verify.sh).
- Add an alert that triggers when a hostpool has >=2 instances failing healthchecks across >1 AZ for >2m. Current alert only fires at >3 failed instances.

Open questions:
- Did the model rollout scheduled for 09:00 overlap with the embeddings load profile? (Priya to confirm release metrics).
- Why did autoscaler not keep min replicas earlier in the morning? Is there a bug in controller or an external manual override?

Quick commands executed (notes):
- kubectl scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=5 -n prod-embeddings
- kubectl logs deployment/autoscaler -n kube-system --since=10h | grep "scale down" > /tmp/autoscaler-scales-2026-03-04.txt
- sudo iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/rules.v4.bak (performed by infra oncall to rollback stray rules)

Follow-ups scheduled:
- 2026-03-04 14:00 - Sync with Priya & Noah to align on postmortem draft and owners. (Calendar invite sent)
- 2026-03-05 - Run autoscaler log audit and raise JIRA with stack traces if reproduced. (owner: Rachel)

Notes to self:
- Keep an eye on embedding mem/cold-starts during next few hours; set an adhoc small load test if useful.
- When drafting postmortem, call out the maintenance job id (maint-2026-03-03-22) and include the iptables diff.

Useful links/refs:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/kv-cache-runbook
- Hostpool configs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Infra/hostpool-configs
- PR for autoscaler fix candidate: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2015
- JIRA: PROD-4872

End of scratchpad.
summary: Morning oncall: resolved embeddings backlog by scaling, fixed hostpool-b healthcheck issue caused by stale iptables rule. Filed PROD-4872 for autoscaler investigation; several runbook TODOs assigned.
